description: Na₅AgGe₂S₇ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six S atoms to form distorted NaS₆ octahedra that share corners with two NaS₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one GeS₄ tetrahedra, edges with four NaS₆ octahedra, and edges with three equivalent GeS₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 8-39°. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.89-3.17 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six S atoms to form NaS₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaS₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent GeS₄ tetrahedra, edges with four equivalent NaS₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent GeS₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 8°. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.83-3.07 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four S atoms. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.81-2.93 Å. Ag is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four S atoms. There are two shorter (2.60 Å) and two longer (2.69 Å) Ag-S bond lengths. Ge is bonded to four S atoms to form GeS₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two NaS₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one GeS₄ tetrahedra, and edges with four NaS₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 19-62°. There are a spread of Ge-S bond distances ranging from 2.21-2.28 Å. There are four inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded to five Na and one Ge atom to form SNa₅Ge octahedra that share corners with two SNa₅Ge octahedra, corners with five equivalent SNa₃AgGe trigonal bipyramids, edges with six SNa₅Ge octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one SNa₃AgGe trigonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-8°. In the second S site, S is bonded to four Na, one Ag, and one Ge atom to form SNa₄AgGe octahedra that share corners with three SNa₅Ge octahedra, corners with two equivalent SNa₃AgGe trigonal bipyramids, edges with five SNa₅Ge octahedra, and edges with three equivalent SNa₃AgGe trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-75°. In the third S site, S is bonded to three Na, one Ag, and one Ge atom to form distorted SNa₃AgGe trigonal bipyramids that share corners with seven SNa₅Ge octahedra, corners with two equivalent SNa₃AgGe trigonal bipyramids, and edges with four SNa₅Ge octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 18-78°. In the fourth S site, S is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Ge atoms.
